description: Compare two or more ACCRUE vaults side by side. Returns each vault's live APYs, TVL, chain, and risk tier, plus a comparison summary highlighting the highest yield, highest TVL, and whether the vaults share a risk tier. Use this for "compare X and Y" or "is Aave or Compound better right now" type questions.

vault_ids.description: Array of 2–6 vault IDs or names to compare.

name: compare_vaults
